appearances.title: TRL async GRPO now powers RL for genomic models, a 2B olympiad prover and multi-harness coding agents
appearances.summary: Hugging Face TRL's asynchronous RL trainer is the base for the RL stage of the Carbon-X genomic model, a 2B proof-writing model in FineEnvs, coding agents from 1.7B to 27B trained inside pi, OpenCode and Hermes, and the async RL in Unsloth, Axolotl and Snowflake Arctic Platform.

appearances.title: FineDNA and Carbon-X open a DNA language-model training stack
appearances.summary: FineDNA is a public dataset for teaching language models DNA: 300B+ tokens of genomic sequence, papers, and mixed DNA-text, plus 200k SFT and 98k RL samples. Training Qwen3-14B on it produces Carbon-X, which the authors report beats other open language models on DNA tasks.
